name: Skulker
summary: +1 Dex; Blindsight 10 feet, Advantage on Stealth to Hide in combat, and missed attacks don't give you away.

benefits.name: Blindsight
benefits.summary: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.
benefits.text: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

benefits.name: Fog of War
benefits.summary: In combat, Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to Hide.
benefits.text: During combat, you have Advantage on any Dexterity (Stealth) check you make as part of the Hide action.

benefits.name: Sniper
benefits.summary: Missing with an attack roll while hidden doesn't reveal your location.
benefits.text: If you make an attack roll while hidden and the roll misses, making it doesn't reveal your location.
